description.title: הבהרת תביעה בעזרת מומחה
description.summary: This table describes the process for claim clarification with the assistance of an expert at Harel. It outlines the plaintiff's rights regarding notice, expert involvement, and limitations on the expert's authority.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת את הבהרת תביעה בעזרת מומחה של הראל. הראל תשלח הודעה מוקדמת למבוטח אם יש צורך במומחה להערכת נזקים, והמומחה לא רשאי לדחות את התביעה או להציע פשרה אלא בנוגע להיקף הנזק, אלא אם הוא עובד הראל העוסק בהתיישבות תביעות. תהליך זה חל על כל התביעות, למעט חקירות סמויות. הראל תענה בכתב לכל פנייה בתוך זמן סביר, ובכל מקרה לא יאוחר מ-30 יום ממועד קבלת הפנייה. במקרה של קשיש, התגובה תינתן תוך 21 יום. מומחה, הערכת נזקים, תביעות הראל.
description.column_axis: rights and procedures regarding expert involvement
notable_values: compromise proposal: limited to damage extent

sketch:
M.  Clarification of a claim with the assistance of an expert
In the event of the need to be assisted by an expert to clarify a claim, where the expert meets the plaintiff or inspects the property, which is the subject of the claim in order to assess the damages caused to that property, in the presence or absence of the plaintiff, the plaintiff shall receive advance notice in regard thereto. The role of the expert regarding clarification of the claim, shall be clarified to him and he will be informed of his/her right to be represented or to consult with an expert on his behalf during clarification of the claim with the assistance help of an expert (all - unless referring to an investigator in the framework of an undercover investigation).
An expert as aforementioned shall not reject the claim in full or in part and shall not propose a compromise except regarding the extent of the damage, unless relating to a Harel employee, whose main activity claims settlement.

טבלה: הבהרת תביעה בעזרת מומחה
This table describes the process for claim clarification with the assistance of an expert at Harel. It outlines the plaintiff's rights regarding notice, expert involvement, and limitations on the expert's authority.
ממדים: claim clarification process steps, rights and procedures regarding expert involvement

M.  Clarification of a claim with the assistance of an expert
In the event of the need to be assisted by an expert to clarify a claim, where the expert meets the plaintiff or inspects the property, which is the subject of the claim in order to assess the damages caused to that property, in the presence or absence of the plaintiff, the plaintiff shall receive advance notice in regard thereto. The role of the expert regarding clarification of the claim, shall be clarified to him and he will be informed of his/her right to be represented or to consult with an expert on his behalf during clarification of the claim with the assistance help of an expert (all - unless referring to an investigator in the framework of an undercover investigation).
An expert as aforementioned shall not reject the claim in full or in part and shall not propose a compromise except regarding the extent of the damage, unless relating to a Harel employee, whose main activity claims settlement.
